title: Law to require DSS to help homeless people in severe winter weather
summary: This bill would require the Department of Social Services to launch a severe winter weather response when temperatures are forecast at 20 degrees or below or other severe conditions occur, including more frequent outreach, warming buses, transportation to shelter and expanded harm reduction access. The response would begin within 24 hours of a forecast and continue for at least 24 hours after conditions end. DSS would also have to identify at-risk unsheltered people each November and report to the Council Speaker before each winter month on its response plans and shelter capacity.
